An interactive portfolio is a space for ideas to take shape. Explore a collection of projects through motion, images and small details. This open-source demo is a starting point for a story of your own.

Start with what you want to share, then make the experience your own. Replace the sample words, add your projects and choose the images that tell their stories. The layout, transitions and interactions are here to help you find a way through.

Every project can be the beginning of another conversation. Follow the links to GitHub, read the README and try an idea for yourself. Adapt what helps, and share what you make. If a project is useful to you, a Star is welcome. What will you build?
